details: Height setting is respected: Low rides about 5 m above the ground 30 m behind, Medium 40/120, High 150/400; the gaze goes up the slope on the climb (pitch up to 100: beyond that MapLibre stops drawing nearby terrain).
Summit: rises like a drone, orbits, stops on the descent axis, dives back to the ground, holds still, then goes.
Descent starts close and gains height and distance; the gaze keeps the horizon in frame.
Arrival: turns back to the summit and, when it is in line of sight, rises and moves toward it.
Never inside the mountain: the eye is lifted ahead of bumps (7 m relief for this style), and the live guard uses the margin the trajectory guarantees.
New cloud renderer look: cauliflower cumulus tops (billow noise), silver lining toward the sun, lighter creases, cirrus veil, sun halo, richer sky.
Inside the cloud is no longer uniform: pockets where it thins out, places where light breaks through (white) and darker blue-grey passages.
Three looks in the style panel when the cloud dive is on: the original smooth golden sea (kept as is), golden cumulus, blue-grey cumulus.
Less grain: each frame averages 2 passes (3 in careful mode) with shifted ray offsets.
The cloud dive now lasts 12 s and is added to the chosen duration, so the trace flyover keeps its full time; more of it is spent inside the clouds.

Format réel de l'API : sommets avec lat/lng/sommet, conditions dans « cond » (HTML nettoyé), tout en chaînes ; les nombres (id, date, altitude, dénivelé) sont convertis pour les applis.
installer-ia.sh demande la clé skitour (SKITOUR_CLE) ; README : où la trouver, comment l'ajouter.
